integrity: Analytical proof specifies the full admissible domain and all global optimizers; a reproducible exact-rational checker supplements but does not substitute for that proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One potentially antagonistic edge at a time, selected from candidate edges even when designed with zero conductance.
Blocks only triangles or bridges; the two spokes within each triangular block have identical unit prices.
The attack acts subtractively on signed conductance rather than removing existing positive conductance; simultaneous attacks are not covered.
Originality is assessed against accessed literature and might be superseded by uncatalogued equivalent results.
title: Sharp single-edge antagonism margins for priced triangular cactus networks
